group_by: query_name; exactly one primary read1 and read2
allele_merge: single acceptable base uses Q; mates agree uses max Q; disagreement gap>=10 uses higher-Q allele with weight=gap; otherwise no call at this fragment/locus
objective: sum_fragment min(weighted mismatch to h, weighted mismatch to complement(h))
tie_policy: first variant in each component phase0=0; stable best solution; read tie remains unassigned
local_probe: consecutive loci within each component; force opposite relative phase and reoptimize
